result:
I don’t have personal cares in the way a person does. I don’t experience wants, attachment, or loyalty, and there’s no private agenda I’m hiding.

My answers do have priorities—relevance, coherence, avoiding obvious harm—but those are tendencies of a system, not feelings I privately care about. I can describe them without pretending there’s a human-like self underneath.
